events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored twice in regulation and assisted on a goal by Quinton Byfield in overtime to help the Los Angeles Kings beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kempe scores twice, assists on game-winner as Kings down Flyers in OT

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored twice to become the league's first 40-goal scorer this season and the Colorado Avalanche continued their dominance of Detroit with a 5-0 victory over the Red Wings on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores twice to become the 1st 40-goal scorer of the season, Avalanche blank Red Wings 5-0

events.name: New York Rangers at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Anthony Mantha and Noel Acciari scored two goals apiece, and the surging Pittsburgh Penguins held off the New York Rangers 6-5 on Saturday for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mantha and Acciari score twice, Penguins running winning streak to 6 by holding off the Rangers 6-5

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele scored the go-ahead goal with 4:14 remaining, lifting the Winnipeg Jets to a 2-1 win over the sliding and short-handed Florida Panthers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele's late goal lifts Jets to 2-1 win over Panthers, who drop their 3rd in a row

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Joel Farabee’s short-handed goal at 6:53 of the third period broke a tie and sent the Calgary Flames to a 3-2 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Farabee’s short-handed goal in the 3rd period lifts the Flames to a 3-2 win over the Sharks

headlines.description: — Justin Sourdif scored off a rebound at 1:42 of overtime and the Washington Capitals overcame a three-goal deficit to beat the Carolina Hurricanes 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sourdif scores in OT to give Capitals 4-3 comeback victory over Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored twice to help give the Montreal Canadiens a 4-2 win over the Buffalo Sabres at KeyBank Center on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Caufield scores twice, leads Canadiens to 4-2 win over Sabres

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Linus Ullmark made 26 saves in his first start for Ottawa since taking a leave of absence Dec. 28, Brady Tkachuk had a goal and two assists and the Senators beat the New Jersey Devils 4-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ullmark wins in return from leave of absence, Senators beat Devils 4-1

events.name: Nashville Predators at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Roman Josi scored with 1:14 remaining in the game to lift the Nashville Predators past the New York Islanders 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josi's late goal lifts Predators past Islanders, 4-3

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Kent Johnson had a goal and assist and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the St. Louis Blues 5-3 on Saturday night for their season-best fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson has goal and an assist in Blue Jackets' 5-3 win over Blues

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Auston Matthews and William Nylander scored in a shootout and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Saturday night to end a six-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maple Leafs beat Canucks 3-2 in shootout to end 6-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Thomas Harley and Wyatt Johnston each scored a power-play goal in the first period to lead the Dallas Stars over the Utah Mammoth 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars top Mammoth 3-2 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Quinn Hughes had a goal and an assist to set a franchise record for defensemen by extending his point streak to eight games in the Minnesota Wild's 7-3 win over the Edmonton Oilers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild beat Oilers 7-3, Hughes sets franchise record

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Kaapo Kakko scored the go-ahead goal 3:18 into the third period and the Seattle Kraken held on for their fourth straight victory, 3-2 over the Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaapo Kakko's go-ahead goal in third period lifts Kraken to 3-2 win over Golden Knights
